Source moved from the etymology dictionary (which blocks automated checks and covers only the name) to the American Meteorological Society's Glossary of Meteorology entry on the monsoon.

The printed question said the monsoon 'arises when the warm winds from India cool down in the heights of the Himalaya' – a muddled premise (the moist air comes from the Indian Ocean, rises against the Himalaya, cools and rains out). Reworded to an open question that states the mechanism correctly; the card's words are kept in cardText.
